info.name: Recipes API
info.description:
CRUD REST API for managing recipes, built with Node.js, Express.js, and Mongoose.

Base URL (local): http://localhost:5000/api/recipes
Base URL (live): https://recipes-app-ryqk.onrender.com/api/recipes

Switch the `baseUrl` collection variable to test locally or against the deployed instance.

variable.description: Set automatically after running 'Create Recipe' (see its Tests tab), or paste an existing recipe's _id here.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Classic Margherita Pizza",
  "description": "A simple, authentic Italian pizza with fresh mozzarella, basil, and tomato sauce.",
  "ingredients": [
    "Pizza dough",
    "San Marzano tomatoes",
    "Fresh mozzarella",
    "Fresh basil",
    "Olive oil",
    "Salt"
  ],
  "instructions": "Preheat oven to 250°C. Spread crushed tomatoes over the dough. Add torn mozzarella. Bake for 10-12 minutes until crust is golden. Top with fresh basil and a drizzle of olive oil before serving.",
  "cookingTime": 25,
  "servings": 4,
  "difficulty": "Easy",
  "category": "Italian"
}

request.description:
Creates a new recipe.

### Required fields
| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| title | String | 3–100 characters |
| description | String | max 500 characters |
| ingredients | String[] | at least one item |
| instructions | String | |
| cookingTime | Number | in minutes, min 1 |
| servings | Number | min 1 |

### Optional fields
| Field | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| difficulty | String (`Easy` \| `Medium` \| `Hard`) | `Medium` |
| category | String | `General` |

### Success response `201 Created`
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Recipe created successfully",
  "data": { "_id": "...", "title": "...", "...": "..." }
}
```

### Validation error `400 Bad Request`
```json
{
  "success": false,
  "message": "Validation failed",
  "errors": ["Recipe title is required"]
}
```

